titulo: Is your graphics card getting too hot? This tip will boost its performance
resumo: Graphics cards don’t simply die of old age — they usually suffocate due to neglect. The biggest enemy is dust, which settles on the cooling fins like an insulating layer and sabotages the cooling performance. However, before you take any action, you should carry out a professional diagnosis. Use the free tool Hwinfo for this. Launch the program in ‘Sensors only’ mode and look for the ‘GPU Hotspot Temperature’ reading under your graphics card. This reading represents the hottest spot directly on the silicon chip. Compare it with the normal ‘GPU Temperature,’ which is the average reading. A difference (delta) of more than 20 degrees Celsius under full load is a clear warning sign. It suggests that contact between the chip and the cooler is poor — for example, because the thermal paste has dried out or is unevenly distributed. If the delta is as high as 30 degrees Celsius or more, the card will already be significantly throttling its clock speed to prevent damage (thermal throttling). When carrying out PC maintenance, do pay special attention to your graphics card. After all, with the right GPU care, you can specifically prevent performance losses. titulo: New Outlook stores your settings in a hidden file. You should back it up
resumo: For the past couple of years, Microsoft has made a concerted effort to move users from the classic Outlook app for Windows 11 to “new” Outlook, a web-based app. If you’re using new Outlook, you should take advantage of the ability to back up your account settings. These settings are stored in the ‘UserSettings.json’ file, which you can find in the ‘C:\Users\[username]\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Olk’ folder. If you have set up multiple accounts in Outlook, you will find separate configuration files in each of the individual user folders. To create a backup, copy this file or these files to another secure location, or include them in the backups created by your backup software. To restore the configuration, simply copy the JSON file back to its original location. If the Olk folder is missing — for example, after reinstalling Outlook — create it manually. The configuration will be applied automatically when you start Outlook. titulo: The U.S. Nuclear Plant Fleet Is Leaning Into AI
resumo: If there is any place that would be off-limits to AI, the control room of a nuclear power plant certainly sounds like one. The nuclear industry is historically cautious and risk averse—understandable given the possible catastrophic consequences of an accident or a mistake. Even well-trained managers struggle with the operational complexity of a nuclear reactor. It’s not the kind of setting that seems well suited to a powerful but error-prone new technology. Reality tells a startlingly different story. A variety of companies have begun to offer AI solutions for nuclear power. This year, nearly the entire fleet of 94 U.S. nuclear reactors has been offered the chance to integrate AI into its operations, and most have taken it.
